lines.zh: ：Ami？……
：怎么了，最好的朋友？
：这是怎么回事？……

lines.en: : Hmm...you must’ve blacked out while we were on our way to the party. But don’t worry! I carried you all the way here by myself because I love you so darn much.
lines.zh: ：嗯……我们去派对的路上你一定是昏过去了。不过别担心！是我一个人一路把你背过来的，因为我实在是太爱你了。
：好吧，可是……
：你手里拿的什么？……
：嗯？拿什么？

lines.en: : That fucking vibrator, idiot?! And why am I shackled to a chair?! What the fuck did you do to me?!
lines.zh: ：那个他妈的按摩棒啊，白痴？！还有我为什么被铐在椅子上？！你他妈对我做了什么？！

lines.en: : Hey, could you slow down? My brain’s too small and undeveloped to process more than one question at a time.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你能不能慢一点？我脑子又小又没发育好，一次处理不了一个以上的问题。
：那是……
：那是摄像机吗？

lines.en: : Are you fucking recording this?! What the hell, Ami?! What’s the meaning of this?! I thought we were going to work together?!
lines.zh: ：你他妈在录像？！搞什么，Ami？！这是什么意思？！我以为我们要一起合作的？！

lines.en: : We {i}are{/i} working together, Maya! This is all part of the plan! It’s not {i}my{/i} fault you decided to start slipping through time and space at the worst possible moment.
lines.zh: ：我们{i}是{/i}在合作啊，Maya！这都是计划的一部分！你自己偏要在最糟糕的时刻开始穿梭时空，这可不能怪{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : You should be {i}thanking{/i} me for taking you somewhere safe instead of letting some random passerby find your unconscious body to use as they please! Aren’t I so nice?!
lines.zh: ：你该{i}谢谢{/i}我把你带到了安全的地方，而不是让随便哪个路过的家伙发现你昏迷的身体随意处置！我是不是特别好？！

lines.en: : You...know about the...{i}thing{/i} that happened to me?...
lines.zh: ：你……知道我身上发生的……{i}那件事{/i}？……

lines.en: : It’s hard to forget a kiss like {i}that,{/i} Maya. You seemed really into it.
lines.zh: ：{i}那样{/i}一个吻很难忘掉，Maya。你当时看起来真的很投入。

lines.en: : You were there?! You remember that?! What the fuck, Ami?! What’s happening to me?! Why are you doing this?!
lines.zh: ：你当时也在？！你记得那个？！搞什么，Ami？！我到底怎么了？！你为什么要这么做？！

lines.en: : Again with the barrage of questions. Would it kill you to just listen every once in a while? I’ll explain everything if you just give me a chance to.
lines.zh: ：又来了，一连串的问题。你就不能偶尔听一次吗？只要你给我个机会，我可以解释一切的。

lines.en: : Fine...I’ll play along. Not like I have a choice in the matter when you’ve got me strapped up like this. So go ahead — explain everything.
lines.zh: ：行……我就陪你演。你都把我这么绑着了，我也没得选。那就说吧——把所有事都解释清楚。

lines.en: : Okay! Just hold on a second, alright? I need to come up with something believable.
lines.zh: ：好！你等一下，好吗？我得先编一个可信的说法。

lines.en: : Hahahahaha! You’re so adorable when you’re flailing around all scared and confused! Or...{i}trying{/i} to flail around, I guess.
lines.zh: ：哈哈哈哈哈！你又怕又懵地乱扑腾的样子太可爱了！或者说……{i}试图{/i}乱扑腾的样子吧。
：不过这很棒，Maya。

lines.en: : It’ll make the video that much more fun to look back on years and years and years from now.
lines.zh: ：这会让这段视频在往后很多很多很多年后再回看时更加有意思。
：你是……
：你是……{i}神{/i}还是什么？……

lines.en: : Well, that’s an interesting theory! How’d you come to that conclusion?
lines.zh: ：嗯，这个猜想挺有意思！你是怎么得出这个结论的？

lines.en: : Well, you’re...if you know what I saw and...you were {i}there{/i} for it...and you brought me {i}here...{/i}you must have some sort of control over this, right?
lines.zh: ：因为，你……如果你知道我所看见的，而且……你当时就{i}在场{/i}……你还把我带到了{i}这儿{/i}……那你一定对这一切有某种掌控，对吧？

lines.en: : Maya, let me ask you something. Do you even know where {i}here{/i} is?
lines.zh: ：Maya，让我问你一件事。你甚至知道{i}这里{/i}是哪里吗？

lines.en: : No! I {i}don’t{/i} know! Some fucking...weird room with a bunch of things vaguely relating to me in it?! Am I {i}supposed{/i} to know?!
lines.zh: ：不知道！我{i}不知道{/i}！某个他妈的……奇怪的房间，里面全是跟我隐约相关的东西？！我{i}应该{/i}知道吗？！

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} You’re not. Because not only does this iteration of you lack the necessary memories to {i}recognize{/i} it, you wouldn’t be able to truly comprehend it even if you did.
lines.zh: ：{i}不{/i}。你不该知道。因为这一版的你不仅缺少{i}认出{/i}它所需的记忆，就算你有，你也无法真正理解它。

lines.en: : Some of those words were way too big for you...
lines.zh: ：刚才有些词对你来说太深奥了……

lines.en: : They were, weren’t they? What do you think {i}that{/i} means, Maya?
lines.zh: ：确实太深奥了，是吧？你觉得{i}这{/i}说明什么，Maya？

lines.en: : Go on. You’re a smart girl. You’ve figured me out in the past. Surely you can do it again {i}now,{/i} can’t you?
lines.zh: ：继续说。你是个聪明的女孩。你过去就把我看透了。{i}现在{/i}你肯定也能再来一次，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to do this, Ami...I just want to see Sensei again...
lines.zh: ：我不想这样，Ami……我只想再见 Sensei……

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Sensei {i}this.{/i} Sensei {i}that.{/i} For millions and millions of years, that’s literally {i}all{/i} you’ve ever done. Why don’t you just get a life already?
lines.zh: ：巴拉巴拉巴拉。Sensei {i}这个{/i}。Sensei {i}那个{/i}。数百万数百万年来，你就{i}只{/i}会做这一件事。你怎么不干脆去好好过日子？

lines.en: : Oh, like {i}you’re{/i} one to talk! You’re the exact same way! And until a few hours ago, I didn’t even realize it had {i}been{/i} that long! Is {i}that{/i} what you showed me?! Were those memories?! They were, right?!
lines.zh: ：哦，说得好像{i}你{/i}有资格说一样！你也一模一样！而直到几个小时前，我甚至都没意识到已经过去{i}那么久{/i}了！{i}这{/i}就是你给我看的吗？！那些是记忆吗？！是的吧？！

lines.en: : Mmmmmm...not quite. I can’t really fathom any situation that would warrant Sensei saying all that weird stuff to you at the end of your last vision. But hey, I guess it’s {i}technically{/i} possible.
lines.zh: ：唔嗯嗯嗯……不太对。我实在想不出有任何情况能让你上一段幻象结尾时 Sensei 对你说那些奇怪的话。不过嘛，我猜{i}技术上{/i}讲也不是没可能。

lines.en: : So all that stuff that he and Ayane had been telling me...about there being {i}another{/i} me...
lines.zh: ：那么他还有 Ayane 一直跟我说的那些……关于还有{i}另一个{/i}我……

lines.en: : That was all true?...Is {i}that{/i} what you’re saying?...
lines.zh: ：都是真的？……你是{i}这个{/i}意思吗？……

lines.en: : Right as rain you are, Maya. Just with one {i}teensy{/i} little caveat — it wasn’t just {i}one.{/i}
lines.zh: ：说得完全正确，Maya。只是有个{i}小小的{/i}附加条件——不止{i}一个{/i}。

lines.en: : In fact, this sort of thing has happened to you {i}tons{/i} of times now! And every single time, it’s {i}started{/i} off great, only to get {i}really{/i} fucking annoying once you start trying to {i}figure things out.{/i}
lines.zh: ：事实上，这种事已经在你身上发生过{i}无数{/i}次了！每一次都是{i}开头{/i}很好，一旦你开始试图{i}搞清楚状况{/i}，就变得他妈的{i}极其{/i}烦人。

lines.en: : Problem is, we’ve encountered a bit of a {i}unique{/i} issue this time since you’re the {i}only{/i} one who was forced to start over.
lines.zh: ：问题在于，这次我们遇到了一个有点{i}特殊{/i}的状况，因为你是{i}唯一{/i}一个被迫从头开始的人。

lines.en: : And that sounds great on paper since I imagine it must torment you pretty terribly having to be constantly reminded that you’re not who you {i}think{/i} you are.
lines.zh: ：纸上听起来这很棒，因为我能想象，被迫不断被提醒你并非你所{i}认为{/i}的那个人，一定让你备受折磨。

lines.en: : But it also means that I now have to deal with everyone bitching and whining about it all day long and it’s really starting to eat into my me-time.
lines.zh: ：但这也意味着我现在得整天应付所有人为此的抱怨和哀嚎，而这真的开始侵占我的私人时间了。

lines.en: : So now {i}I{/i} have to suffer?...Even if you know I’m not the same girl who allegedly {i}figured things out?...{/i}
lines.zh: ：所以现在轮到{i}我{/i}受苦了？……就算你知道我并不是那个据说把事情{i}搞明白{/i}的女孩？……

lines.en: : Are you suffering right now, Maya?
lines.zh: ：你现在在受苦吗，Maya？

lines.en: : Yes! I already told you, I just want to see Sensei again! I don’t care about any of this weird manga-adjacent time shit! I’ll ignore everything if you just let me go!
lines.zh: ：是的！我跟你说了，我只想再见 Sensei！我才不在乎这些跟漫画似的时空破事！只要你放我走，我可以无视一切！

lines.en: : Oh my God...I’m so sorry. I had no idea your pain and anguish was so deep.
lines.zh: ：我的天……我太抱歉了。我完全不知道你的痛苦与煎熬如此之深。

lines.en: : But the good news is I know just how to make it up to you!
lines.zh: ：不过好消息是，我知道该怎么补偿你！
：嗯呃！？

lines.en: : Let’s get one thing straight — no matter how many times you deceive yourself into believing you’re the main heroine, there will always be someone who’s been doing this way longer than you.
lines.zh: ：有件事我们得说清楚——不管你多少次骗自己相信你才是女主角，总会有个人做这件事做得比你久得多。
：想猜猜是谁吗？
：不……不要！

lines.en: : Good answer! Here, I’ll loosen my grip a little as means of rewarding you for your obedience.
lines.zh: ：回答得好！来，我把手松一点，作为对你顺从的奖励。

lines.en: : Unless you’d {i}like{/i} me to squeeze a little tighter, of course. You {i}have{/i} always been into the rough stuff, after all.
lines.zh: ：当然，除非你{i}想{/i}让我再勒紧一点。毕竟你{i}一向{/i}喜欢粗野的那一套。
：你……想从我这里要什么？

lines.en: : Right now? Or in general? Because right now, I just want to take a little of my frustration out on this fresh body and mind of yours. In general...mutual understanding, perhaps?
lines.zh: ：现在？还是总的来说？因为现在，我只是想在我这副新鲜的躯体和头脑上发泄一点我的挫败感。总的来说……也许是想互相理解？
：理解……什么？

lines.en: : That you’ll stop digging through my toy box whenever I leave the house. And that you’ll stop trying to take my place.
lines.zh: ：理解你该别在我出门的时候翻我的玩具箱。也别再试图取代我。

lines.en: : Because it’s one thing to borrow my things, and another to borrow my clothes. But when you’re doing {i}both{/i} at the same time...you're just pretending to be me.
lines.zh: ：因为借我的东西是一回事，借我的衣服是另一回事。可当你同时做这{i}两件事{/i}……你就只是在假装是我。

lines.en: : So of course I’m going to get a little weirded out. That’s creepy as hell.
lines.zh: ：所以我当然会觉得有点不对劲。那太他妈的瘆人了。

lines.en: : But why...are you even telling me all of this?...Wouldn’t it have been better to just...keep me in the dark?...
lines.zh: ：可你为什么……要告诉我这些？……把我蒙在鼓里，不是更好吗？……

lines.en: : See, that’s what I thought too. So that’s what I did. But now, I’m not sure that’s going to work anymore.
lines.zh: ：你看，我本来也这么想。所以我就是这么做的。但现在，我不确定那样还管不管用了。

lines.en: : So you get to be the first person to ever see this super personal side of me! Doesn’t that make you happy?!
lines.zh: ：所以你有幸成为第一个见到我这一面的人！这难道不让你开心吗？！
：我一直……爱着你，Ami……

lines.en: : Aaaaaaand more unwanted affection from a girl who shouldn’t exist! But sure, I love you too.
lines.zh: ：然后又是来自一个不该存在的女孩的多余爱意！不过嘛，我也爱你。

lines.en: : If I didn’t, I wouldn’t share things like this with you. Especially when it’s probably obvious how much I hate sharing in the first place.
lines.zh: ：如果我不爱，我就不会跟你分享这些。尤其是这事大概很明显，我本来就极其讨厌分享。

lines.en: : What can I say...that will get me out of this chair?...
lines.zh: ：我能说什么……才能让我离开这把椅子？……

lines.en: : Nothing yet. It’s playtime now. But maybe after we’re done, I’ll let you walk out of here in one piece? Or not. It’s not really my say in the first place.
lines.zh: ：暂时没什么。现在是玩耍时间。不过也许等我们结束后，我会让你完整地走出去？或者不会。这其实不是我说了算。

lines.en: : But hey, that just makes me feel better about sharing my deepest, darkest secret with you since I might get a {i}new{/i} Maya once we’re reset again.
lines.zh: ：不过嘿，这反而让我更安心地把最深、最黑暗的秘密跟你分享，因为我们再次重置时，我可能会得到一个全{i}新{/i}的 Maya。

lines.en: : If not, though — at least you can take solace in the fact that your extremely brief existence here has managed to impact me greatly! Even if you’re little more than just a replica at the end of the day.
lines.zh: ：如果不会的话——至少你可以安慰自己，你在此处极其短暂的存在已经深深地影响了我！哪怕说到底你不过是个复制品。
：复……复制品？……

lines.en: : That’s right. {i}Every single one of you.{/i} This is {i}my{/i} world. {i}I’m{/i} real. You and all of those other girls are tools. But {i}you’re{/i} a good tool. And we’ve had a {i}lot{/i} of success teaming up in the past.
lines.zh: ：没错。{i}你们每一个都是{/i}。这是{i}我的{/i}世界。{i}我是{/i}真的。你和其他所有那些女孩都是工具。但{i}你是{/i}个好工具。过去我们合作过{i}很多{/i}次，都很成功。

lines.en: : I wonder if your body still responds the same way? I’m worried this new brand of fear might water it down.
lines.zh: ：我很好奇你的身体还会不会有同样的反应？我担心这种新式的恐惧会冲淡它。
：你……真的要……

lines.en: : You want it, right? I’m the next best thing after Sensei. And this might very well be the last chance you ever get to have some type of sex before you pop again.
lines.zh: ：你想要，对吧？我是仅次于 Sensei 的第二选择。而这很可能是在你再次「弹出」之前最后一次能获得某种性爱的机会。
：可你甚至……不{i}喜欢{/i}女生……

lines.en: : Maya...don’t take this the wrong way, but you’re barely even a {i}girl{/i} to me. You’re just a...thing. A doll. And this little wand of mine is like...the equivalent of brushing my dolly’s hair.
lines.zh: ：Maya……别误会，但你在我眼里几乎算不上{i}女生{/i}。你只是个……东西。一个洋娃娃。而我这根小魔杖就像……相当于在给我的洋娃娃梳头。

lines.en: : Would any of this have happened...if Niki didn’t move in?...
lines.zh: ：如果 Niki 没有搬进来……这一切还会发生吗？……

lines.en: : I’ll bet {i}that’s{/i} the “development” that’s got you the most worried, right?...
lines.zh: ：我敢打赌，{i}那就是{/i}那个让你最担心的「发展」，对吧？……

lines.en: : Because I know you. You’re like me. You know we can’t compete with her....You said it earlier. That’s why we made a plan to...drag him back together...
lines.zh: ：因为我了解你。你和我一样。你知道我们比不过她……你之前也说过了。所以我们才定了个计划……一起把他拖回来……

lines.en: : And we can still do that, Ami...I don’t care that you’re a...psychopath who implants false memories into my head and...strips me and ties me to a chair! We can coexist! I’m fine with second place if I’m second to you!
lines.zh: ：而我们现在还能那么做，Ami……我不在乎你是个……往我脑子里植入虚假记忆，还……把我扒光绑在椅子上的精神病！我们可以共存！只要能排在你后面，我甘愿当第二！

lines.en: : Yeaaaaaaah...the Niki thing’s a real bump in the road for sure. And, believe it or not, I actually wasn’t lying when I brought up the idea of teaming up with you. Like I said, it’s worked before.
lines.zh: ：是呀呀呀……Niki 这件事确实是个大障碍。而且信不信由你，我提起跟你合作的时候其实没撒谎。就像我说的，以前奏效过。

lines.en: : But I’ve gotta test your {i}aptitude{/i} first...
lines.zh: ：但我得先测试一下你的{i}资质{/i}……

lines.en: : I don’t want a pet who isn’t loyal.
lines.zh: ：我不要一只不忠心的宠物。

lines.en: : You’re lucky I’m a cat person. I bet a dog could do the job even better if given the opportunity.
lines.zh: ：算你运气好，我是猫派。我敢说，给狗一个机会，它说不定能做得更好。

lines.en: : Do you think you can be loyal, Maya? To {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: ：你觉得你能忠心吗，Maya？对{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : Can I still be in love with someone else?...
lines.zh: ：我还能继续爱别人吗？……

lines.en: : You can {i}love...{/i}just like a cat does...but you’ll never be {i}in love.{/i} That’s for humans.
lines.zh: ：你可以像猫那样……{i}去爱{/i}……但你永远不会{i}陷入爱河{/i}。那是人类的事。

lines.en: : I’ll let you sleep next to us in bed, though. Does that work?
lines.zh: ：不过我会允许你睡在我们床上。这样行吗？
：不行……

lines.en: : Even if I’m not the version of myself he wants, it doesn’t mean he won’t {i}grow{/i} to want me. So I don’t want to just be a pet, Ami. I want to be a girl. I want to love him the same way you do.
lines.zh: ：就算我不是他想要的那个版本的我，也不代表他不会{i}渐渐{/i}想要我。所以我不想只当一只宠物，Ami。我想当一个女孩。我想像你一样爱他。
：哎呀呀，Maya！太可爱了！

lines.en: : Now I want to brush your hair even more!
lines.zh: ：现在我就更想给你梳头了！

lines.en: : What happened to you, Ami?...The you from my memories is so much brighter than whatever {i}this{/i} is.
lines.zh: ：你到底怎么了，Ami？……我记忆里的你比现在{i}这个样子{/i}明亮得多。

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is what happens when you’ve grown tired of being tired.
lines.zh: ：{i}这{/i}就是你厌倦了疲倦之后会发生的事。

lines.en: : It’s not all rainbows and unrequited love and {i}stars{/i} and watching all of your friends fuck the man you pine for because your shitty self-esteem has persuaded you to take up the role of a tragic heroine.
lines.zh: ：这里可不是什么彩虹、单恋和{i}星星{/i}，也不是眼睁睁看着你所有的朋友都去操你心心念念的那个男人，只因为你那点可怜的自尊心说服你扮演一个悲剧女主角。

lines.en: : I’m sure I was like that once too. But I stopped understanding the idea of “patience” when I realized just how infinite time here really is.
lines.zh: ：我大概也曾经是那样。但当我意识到这里的时间究竟有多无限之后，我就不再理解「耐心」这个概念了。

lines.en: : Now, I just {i}take{/i} what I want. And if I’m unlucky enough to end up in a world where that doesn’t work out-
lines.zh: ：现在，我想要什么就直接{i}拿{/i}。而如果我不幸落到一个行不通的世界里——
：那我就把这{i}世界{/i}拿走。

lines.en: : Now be a good girl and think about what that means while I make you cum your cute little brains out.
lines.zh: ：现在做个好孩子，想想那意味着什么，同时我让你把那点可爱的小脑浆都高潮出来。

lines.en: : Oh, and smile for the camera while you’re at it. A little happiness goes a long, long way!
lines.zh: ：哦，顺便对着镜头笑一个。一点点快乐能走出很远很远的路！
：Ami！不要！求你！
